summary.value: Take an action and spend 5 MP to make a free attack with an equipped heavy melee weapon that loses and cannot gain multi

system.description: Take an action and spend 5 MP to make a free attack with an equipped heavy melee weapon that loses and cannot gain multi. On a hit, deal (SL x 2) physical damage to up to one other enemy within melee reach (+5 at level 20+, +10 at level 40+). You may spend up to (SL x 2) more MP to inflict dazed on one target of this skill per 5 MP spent.
